_schema: This fixture is the single shared manifest for splitting docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
(base, 1310 lines at commit ac612eb) into docs/architecture/*.md plus the
docs/index.md and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md-stub deliverables. It is read by both
split.mjs (generate) and unsplit.mjs (reverse round-trip), so it is the one
place that encodes 'byte-identical except link rewrites, heading promotion,
and added ledes'.
LOCATOR RULE: every segment is located in the base file by `firstLine`
(the exact, verbatim base text at that 1-indexed line number) via an exact,
whole-line string match. `firstLine` is the ONLY locator. `lastLine` is a
redundant assertion only -- the base text at (firstLine's line number + lines
- 1) must equal `lastLine` -- and must NEVER be used to locate a segment,
because 13 of this file's 14 segment end lines are blank strings and would
collide against nearly every other blank line in the document. Line 1310
(the file's actual last line) is the one segment end line that is not blank.
`firstLineOutput` is the exact generated-file string for that same line,
recorded literally rather than computed from `shift` at test time. For 12 of
the 14 segments this literal happens to equal the mechanical result of
removing `-shift` leading '#' characters from an ATX heading line (heading
PROMOTION: shift -1 turns '### X' into '## X', since a section that used to
be nested under the monolith's single H1 is now nested one level shallower
under its own file's H1). For exactly 2 segments -- pipeline.md's [7-94] and
failure-semantics.md's [1290-1310] -- the first line is a FOLD, not a shift
result: '## Pipeline' and '## Failure semantics' become the new file's own H1
('# Pipeline', '# Failure semantics') rather than being demoted by the
file's uniform shift. Arithmetically a -1 shift on a level-2 heading would
produce the same string, which is exactly why the fixture calls these out by
name in `folds` and records their `firstLineOutput` literally: the two are
conceptually different operations that happen to coincide numerically for
these two lines only.
IMPORTANT: tests/fixtures/ is NOT discovered by a bare `node --test` (this
repo's test_command runs plain `node --test`, which auto-discovers
tests/*.test.js -- files directly under tests/ -- not arbitrary data under
tests/fixtures/). This JSON is inert data; the gate that reads it lives in
tests/architecture-split.test.js.
`sha256` is intentionally empty at this stage (task 1, before any output file
exists): task 3 fills it in, one digest per generated output file, once
split.mjs has actually written docs/architecture/*.md, docs/index.md, and the
docs/ARCHITECTURE.md stub.

_schema: One digest per generated output file (docs/architecture/*.md, the ten keys
under `outputs` above), plus one `reconstructed` digest for the full
document. Both are computed the same GIT-FREE way tests/architecture-provenance.test.js
recomputes them: read each committed output file, locate every segment by
an exact whole-line search for its `firstLineOutput`, take `lines` lines
from there (padding back any trailing blank line writeLines() stripped at
generation time, then pinning the final line to `lastLine`), re-promote
headings by `-shift` (or restore the literal fold `from` text on a fold's
own first line), then either (a) join that one file's own segments with a
single blank line between them, in the file's own declared order -- this
is the per-file digest below, catching a hand-edit to THAT file's moved
prose -- or (b) place every segment (plus the two dropped lines) at its
fixed position in the base document's own SOURCE order (a hardcoded fact
about the frozen base commit, not re-derived from git) and reverse the 13
rewrites/4 proseRefs, then hash the whole 1310-line result -- this is
`reconstructed`, and it was verified once, non-committed, against
`git show ac612eb07f68d57e8f43a312cc76275064930bde:docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`
with an EMPTY diff (no allow-list entries were needed; the transform is
exact) before being baked in here as the durable proof. Both computations
are pure functions of committed files plus this fixture: no git call is
needed to reproduce either value again.
